docs.title: DVR Smart Edit
docs.text: DVR Smart Edit automates and streamlines DaVinci Resolve editing workflows.

docs.title: Features
docs.text:
• Text+ Utilities: Copy Text+ styles, generate text, import/export subtitles.
  • Effect Control: Apply effects based on keywords.

docs.title: Text+ Utilities
docs.text: DVR Smart Edit provides essential utilities for Text+.

docs.title: Generate Text+
docs.text:
Generate Text+ clips from subtitle track or SRT file.

  1. Open Smart Edit Menu:

    • Open menu from Workspace > Scripts > SmartEdit > Menu.
    • Go to Text+ tab.

  2. Generate:

    • Set parameters.
    • Click Generate.

docs.title: Copy Text+ Style
docs.text:
1. Select Style:

    • In Media Pool, select the Text+ clip with desired style.

  2. Open Text+ Utilities Menu:

    • In timeline, select the Text+ clip to apply style to.
    • In Inspector, right click text edit control and choose SmartEdit Text+ Menu

  3. Apply Style:

    • Under Text+ Utilities Menu > Styling > Copy Style from Media Pool, select:
    • to This Clip: Apply style to the selected clip in timeline.
    • to This Track: Apply style to every Text+ clips in the track where the selected clip belong to.
    • to All: Apply style to all Text+ clips in the timeline.

docs.title: Explore Other Features
docs.text:
• Access tools via Smart Edit Menu and Text+ Utilities Menu
  • Hover over controls for tooltips to learn more about each feature.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text: Choose one of the following methods to install DVR Smart Edit:

docs.title: Install from Release Page
docs.text:
1. Download Installer:

    • Visit the Release Page and download the latest archive containing install.py.

  2. Drag and Drop:

    • In DaVinci Resolve, open the Console via Workspace > Console.
    • Drag the install.py file into the Console.

  3. Complete Installation:

    • Restart DaVinci Resolve after installation.

docs.title: Install via Pip
docs.text:
1. Open your terminal or command prompt.
  2. Run: 
    pip install dvr_smart_edit

Install Development Version

See Developer Installation Guide for instructions.
